adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#destroy`, the code fetches with `EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` and then unconditionally calls `host.destroy`. If the record doesn’t exist (missing/already-deleted id), `host` will be `nil` and `nil.destroy` will raise `NoMethodError`, producing a 500 rather than a controlled 404/not-found response. This behavior is directly implied by the diff.
